question: On what basis is the Vaiśya said to be distinguished in this classification?
premises: Consecration is presented as a basis of distinction.
Birth is also mentioned in the statement.
The Vaiśya is the subject of this declaration.
inference: Therefore this distinction is stated with reference to consecration and birth in the case of the Vaiśya.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic force of mucyate here is somewhat unclear; it is taken as declarative.
plain_english: This distinction is by consecration; with respect to birth, the Vaiśya is stated.
